cards.imageAlt: Figure 26，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please make a brief description about the picture.
cards.referenceText: As we can see, the aircraft has skidded off the runway and stopped on the shoulder meters away from the edge of runway. The right wheels have sunk into the soft ground of the runway shoulder. All on board have evacuated safely and there is no fire. Wheel marks are left on the muddy runway shoulder clearly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如图所见，飞机滑出跑道并在跑道边缘几米外的跑道道肩停下。飞机的右轮陷入了跑道道肩的软路基内。机上所有人员安全撤离飞机，并且飞机未发生火灾。飞机的轮辙在泥泞的跑道道肩内清晰可见。

cards.audioText: When does this accident probably happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 这起事故可能在什么时候发生？
cards.referenceText: According to my understanding, it may happen during landing. There might be mechanical errors with the aircraft and the pilot can not stop the aircraft fully on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据我的理解，事故可能发生在着陆时。飞机可能出现机械故障，飞行员无法在跑道上完全停止飞机。

cards.audioText: What was the possible cause of this incident?
cards.audioTextZh: 事故可能的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I guess there were two possible causes, one was that the aircraft experienced a hard landing (land at a higher speed) so it could not be fully stopped on the runway. The other situation might be that there was something wrong with the thrust reverser or brake resulting in the aircraft skidding off the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为可能有两个原因，一个是飞机进行硬着陆（以高速着陆），所以飞机无法在跑道完全停止。另一个是飞机的反推力装置或刹车可能出现问题导致飞机滑出跑道。

cards.audioText: Do you know some factors that may cause overrun?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道可能引发飞机冲出跑道的原因吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, many factors will affect the stopping of the aircraft and may cause overrun, such as runway conditions, weather conditions, as well as human factors. If the runway is very slippery and braking action is poor, the aircraft may run out of the runway. If the aircraft encountered low visibility when landing, the possibility of overrun becomes higher, and if the pilot has a poor direction control, the aircraft may skid off the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 知道。许多因素可能会影响飞机停止并让飞机冲出跑道，例如跑道状况、气象情况，同时也有人为因素。如果跑道滑、刹车效应差，飞机可能会冲出跑道。如果飞机在着陆时能见度低，那么冲出跑道的可能性会增高。如果飞行员对飞机的方向控制较差，飞机就有可能冲出跑道。

cards.audioText: Did you experience any emergency in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行时经历过什么紧急情况吗？
cards.referenceText: I have never encountered any in-flight emergency. But my colleague has. One time when he flew from Wuhan to Beijing, during taxiing, he heard the APU fire warning. Immediately he reported the situation to ATC, completed the memory items and made the emergency evacuation. Only one passenger was injured during the evacuation. But after the investigation, the fire warning was proved to be a false signal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行中从未遇到过紧急情况，但是我的同事遇到过。一次他从武汉飞往北京，在滑行时他听到了APU火警警报。他立刻向ATC报告情况，完成记忆程序并进行紧急撤离。仅有一位乘客在紧急撤离中受伤。但是经过调查，火警警报被证实为错误信号。

cards.audioText: Can you imagine how would you feel in case of emergencies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能假设在紧急情况下你会是什么感觉吗？
cards.referenceText: I think every pilot would feel stressed and nervous when he encounters an emergency. But we should have ability to promptly adjust our attitude. In fact, we have training twice a year about facing emergencies. I don't think it's hard to deal with emergencies if we can keep calm and make quick decision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为每位飞行员在遭遇紧急情况时都会感到有压力和紧张，但是我们应该有能力迅速调整自己的心态。事实上，飞行员每年都会接受两次关于紧急情况的训练。我认为如果飞行员能保持冷静并快速作出判断那么处理紧急情况并不是件难事。

cards.audioText: How to deal with abnormal events?
cards.referenceText: As a captain, firstly, we must keep calm and take a good control of the aircraft whenever unusual things happen. At the same time, we must advise ATC our situation and make right judgment, and follow relevant procedure and checklist to ensure the safety of flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为机长，首先，不论何时发生突发事件，我们应该保持冷静并保持对飞机的良好控制。同时，我们必须向ATC报告情况并作出正确判断，执行相关的程序来确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: As we can guess from the picture, passengers all leave the flight successfully. In your opinion, how to improve an emergency evacuation performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中我们可以猜测到乘客全部成功进行撤离。你认为如何能够提高紧急撤离的表现？
cards.referenceText: I think the success of the evacuation largely depends on the enhanced crew procedures. The crew should be trained with proper procedures in controlling and balancing the flow of passengers to reduce evacuation time significantly, which could save lives in a real and catastrophic situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为紧急撤离的成功很大程度取决于提高的改进后机组的流程。机组人员应该接受撤离流程的训练，学习如何控制和平衡撤离时的乘客流量，从而减少紧急撤离的时间，这可以在发生灾难时拯救大家的生命。
